pages.text: Bix wants to go to the park.
First, Bix puts on a blue T-shirt.
Then Bix puts on a green jacket.
Now the socks. Oh! They are on Bix's hands! Ha, ha!
Socks go on your feet, Bix!
Then Bix puts on red shoes.
Last, Bix puts on a hat. Let's go!
